+from django.test import TestCase

+class SelfReferencingFKOrderByTest(TestCase):
+    def test_order_by_root_id(self):
+        """Test that order_by('record__root_id') doesn't add extra JOIN and respects explicit ordering"""
+        from django.db import connection
+        from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext
+        
+        # Create test data
+        root1 = OneModel.objects.create(id=1, oneval=1, root=None)
+        root2 = OneModel.objects.create(id=2, oneval=2, root=None)
+        root3 = OneModel.objects.create(id=3, oneval=3, root=None)
+        
+        child1 = OneModel.objects.create(id=4, oneval=1, root=root1)
+        child2 = OneModel.objects.create(id=5, oneval=2, root=root2)
+        child3 = OneModel.objects.create(id=6, oneval=3, root=root3)
+        
+        TwoModel.objects.create(id=1, record=child1, twoval=10)
+        TwoModel.objects.create(id=2, record=child2, twoval=20)
+        TwoModel.objects.create(id=3, record=child3, twoval=30)
+        
+        # Test the query
+        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
+            qs = TwoModel.objects.filter(record__oneval__in=[1,2,3])
+            qs = qs.order_by("record__root_id")
+            print("Query:", qs.query)
+            
+            # Check the SQL
+            sql = str(qs.query)
+            print("SQL:", sql)
+            
+            # Should have only ONE join (not two)
+            join_count = sql.count("JOIN")
+            print(f"JOIN count: {join_count}")
+            
+            # Should be ASC (not DESC from the model's default ordering)
+            order_direction = "ASC" if "ASC" in sql else "DESC" if "DESC" in sql else "NONE"
+            print(f"Order direction: {order_direction}")
+            
+            # Execute to make sure it works
+            results = list(qs)
+            print(f"Results: {[(r.id, r.record_id, r.record.root_id) for r in results]}")
+            
+            # Assertions
+            self.assertEqual(join_count, 1, f"Expected 1 JOIN, got {join_count}")
+            self.assertIn("ASC", sql, "Expected ASC ordering, not DESC")
